import json,urllib.request
M='http://127.0.0.1:60543'
exp=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(M+'/api/2.0/mlflow/experiments/get-by-name?experiment_name=pixelgym-grounding'))['experiment']
req=urllib.request.Request(M+'/api/2.0/mlflow/runs/search',data=json.dumps({'experiment_ids':[exp['experiment_id']],'max_results':20}).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
from pixelgym.platform.mlflow_tracking import RUN_PARAM_KEYS
for run in json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req))['runs']:
    params={p['key']:p['value'] for p in run['data'].get('params',[])}; tags={t['key']:t['value'] for t in run['data'].get('tags',[])}
    print(json.dumps({'run_id':run['info']['run_id'],'status':run['info']['status'],'model':params.get('model'),'code_revision':params.get('code_revision'),'params_match_contract':set(params)==set(RUN_PARAM_KEYS),'missing_params':sorted(set(RUN_PARAM_KEYS)-set(params)),'metaflow_pathspec':tags.get('metaflow.pathspec'),'synthetic':tags.get('pixelgym.synthetic'),'gate_status':tags.get('gate_status')}))
